The vets themselves are amazing, and I have nothing but praise for their care and professionalism but the reception service has always been extremely frustrating.
On two separate occasions with both of my cats, I had to bypass reception and contact the vets directly because the receptionist failed to recognise the urgency of the situation. One of my cats was literally dying, yet a routine check-up was treated as a higher priority than an emergency and again I had to make sure I got directly through to the veterinary team which did consider it an emergency. On another occasion, my other cat had suffered a bite and was told to wait more than 24 hours because the agenda is full.
I understand receptionists have to manage appointments and prioritise patients, but there needs to be BETTER judgement when someone is calling with a genuine emergency. It is incredibly stressful to have to argue your case or find another way to reach a vet when you are already worried about your pet.

P.S. Please listen back to your phone recordings before accusing clients of being rude or shouting. During one call, the receptionist accused me of “shouting” while she clearly wasn't even listening to what I was saying, and then hung up while I was still speaking. On another call, I said that the clinic was  trash and considering the way my emergency was handled, was an expression of my frustration and opinion. Apparently, they both need a refresher on the difference between someone being upset and someone actually being abusive or rude.

Ps2: same issue happened to my neighbours and their 2 cats and they decided to change vets

Thank you for your 5 star review, we really appreciate it. 
The team at Paxton Vets

Paxton are great vets. Professional, kind and helpful. I had to take my dog in for a fox grass seed in his ear. The vet saw him straight away and he had a sedation to have it removed. It was all done in a matter of hours. No issues, no problems. Fast and effective. They took such great care of him. They even charged me less than they quoted it could be. I couldn’t be happier. I would definitely recommend Paxton Vets.
